name: Break
doc: Break (the spell): the root - every 20 ticks the target task of the next action on its first target: the stone shell's prim-model play, the target hidden and drawn turning to stone (its polygons re-textured by a dither table), the debris falling and sparks, the sound; the status. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag117_break.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and dither table in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Target
parts.doc: One target task an action on its first target: the stone shell's prim-model play, the target drawn turning to stone, the debris and sparks, the sound; the status

params.label: Status tick
params.doc: The status (the action's result) at this tick of the target task

params.label: Shell
params.doc: The prim-model layout shell (its models' animation)
